learning_plan.execution_strategy_summary: This roadmap compresses lower-hire-impact material and reallocates time toward the highest-impact levers for an AI/ML Engineer (deep learning, end-to-end projects, interview readiness, and practical deployment). It preserves the prerequisite order but merges and rebalances modules so: (1) foundations are completed early, (2) interview prep (DSA + system-design/mocks) starts in month 1 and ramps, (3) portfolio work begins immediately and grows in complexity, (4) production skills (Docker/REST/MLOps) and deployment on AWS are covered later but with sufficient hands-on time to demonstrate deployed projects. 540 hours (≈93.75% of available) are allocated to structured work; 36 hours are left as a reserved buffer for unexpected delays, company-specific prep, or additional mock interviews. The plan balances four tracks (Core Technical Mastery, Interview Preparation, Portfolio Development, Career Execution) each month so the candidate always has interview-ready artifacts and practiced narratives while gaining technical depth progressively.

core_track.task: Math & statistics: linear algebra, gradients, probability basics (start)
NumPy & Pandas fundamentals: vectorization, basic dataframe ops, ingestion
Software-engineering intro: Git basics, project structure, simple modular code

interview_track.task: DSA fundamentals: arrays, strings, complexity, 10 practice problems (easy→medium)

portfolio_track.task: Project 1: problem selection, dataset search, repo & README scaffold, initial EDA

career_track.task: Resume/LinkedIn / GitHub baseline: concise bullets, project landing page draft

monthly_plan.milestone: Foundations started: math + data basics. DSA practice started. Project 1 scoped and repo created; resume baseline drafted.

core_track.task: Finish math foundation: multivariate calculus, optimization basics
Pandas: groupby, merge, pivot, efficient I/O; SQL fundamentals intro (SELECT/JOIN)
Machine Learning fundamentals: scikit-learn pipeline intro, linear/logistic regression, regularization (start)

interview_track.task: DSA practice: medium problems, two-pointer & sliding-window patterns

portfolio_track.task: Project 1: deeper EDA, baseline models and experiment log (notebook + README)

monthly_plan.milestone: Math completed; data skills and basic SQL able to prepare datasets. First ML baselines implemented. DSA practice consistency established. Project 1 baseline ready.

core_track.task: Finish advanced Pandas/SQL exercises; large-data I/O patterns and chunking
ML fundamentals: decision trees, random forests, model selection, pipelines & CV (continue)
Feature engineering & preprocessing: imputation, encoding, scaling, feature creation (start)
Engineering: testing basics for data/pipeline code, simple modularization

interview_track.task: DSA practice: medium problems focusing on trees/graphs basics

portfolio_track.task: Project 1: iterate on features, cross-validation, metric-driven improvements

monthly_plan.milestone: Classical ML competency: pipelines, CV, feature engineering. Project 1 improved with proper validation. DSA progress steady (tree/graph basics).

core_track.task: Finish ML fundamentals: unsupervised methods, PCA, bias-variance and model selection wrap-up
Finish feature engineering: pipelines that prevent leakage, dimensionality reduction
Model evaluation & HPO: metrics, CV strategies, intro to grid/random search and Optuna concepts (start)
Deep Learning: intro to neural nets, Keras API, basic training loops (start)

portfolio_track.task: Project 1: finalize write-up and one-page summary; prepare short demo

monthly_plan.milestone: Classical ML & evaluation solid; basic HPO introduced. Deep learning work started. Project 1 polished and ready to show.

core_track.task: Deep Learning: CNNs / transfer learning basics, practical Keras workflows
Model evaluation & HPO: nested CV, calibration, error analysis and debugging
Finish feature engineering corner cases and reproducible pipelines
Software engineering: unit tests for data pipelines, basic CI concepts

interview_track.task: DSA practice: algorithm patterns review and timed problem solving (medium→hard)

portfolio_track.task: Capstone: Project 2 (DL) scoping, dataset prep, initial model experiments

career_track.task: Project & resume updates: incorporate Project 1 results and metrics into bullets

monthly_plan.milestone: Deep learning upskilling continues. HPO & robust evaluation techniques integrated. Project 2 begun; DSA practice intensifying.

core_track.task: Deep Learning: CNNs advanced, custom training loops, data pipelines (tf.data), mixed precision
Finish Model Eval & HPO: Optuna workflows, experiment tracking basics (MLflow/logging)
MLOps & deployment: Docker basics, building a model-serving container (start)
AWS fundamentals for ML: S3, EC2, IAM overview (start)

interview_track.task: DSA: final polish (remaining problems), short timed mock sessions

portfolio_track.task: Capstone: Project 2 (DL) continued – model improvements, transfer learning or transformer fine-tuning

career_track.task: Project demo rehearsals & short video demo recording (supporting portfolio)

monthly_plan.milestone: Deep learning competency increased (practical CNN/transfer learning). Docker and AWS intro started. Project 2 demonstrating significant DL results. DSA maintenance in place.

core_track.task: Deep Learning: Transformers / attention overview and fine-tuning pre-trained models (continue)
MLOps: model serving patterns, TF SavedModel, REST API design and Flask prototype
AWS: containers on ECS/EKS concepts, SageMaker overview and cost-conscious patterns (continue)
Optional high-leverage add-ons: PostgreSQL EXPLAIN/indices, Linux basics
Software engineering: finish any remaining cleanups, test coverage for project pipelines

portfolio_track.task: Capstone: Project 2 completion and start Project 3 (end-to-end deployed): design and plan

monthly_plan.milestone: Transformers/transfer learning furthered. MLOps and AWS skills matured enough to design deployment. Project 2 completed; Project 3 plan ready.

core_track.task: Deep Learning: finish remaining advanced topics and tie into Project 3 needs (finalize models)
MLOps: finalize Docker container, REST API for inference, basic monitoring/logging
AWS: deploy container (ECS/SageMaker/EC2 small demo) and confirm end-to-end pipeline
Optional: finish remaining add-on tasks (2 hours)

interview_track.task: Interview sprint: 2–3 full mock sessions (coding + system design + behavioral), record feedback and iterate
interview_track.mapped_module: Interview & Mock Prep (module 13 style - taken from planned hours)

portfolio_track.task: Capstone: Project 3 finish deployment, prepare one-page summaries and polished GitHub repos (short polish)

monthly_plan.milestone: Final month focused on interview simulations, finishing Project 3 deployment, and packaging the portfolio for hiring outreach.

learning_plan.final_readiness_summary: After 8 months (540 planned hours + 36-hour buffer), the candidate will have: (1) solid mathematical and classical-ML foundations; (2) practical proficiency in TensorFlow/Keras and applied deep learning (CNNs and transformer fine-tuning); (3) multiple polished portfolio projects: a classical ML project, a deep-learning project with clear results, and an end-to-end deployed model (container + REST API + AWS demo); (4) demonstrable engineering practices (Git, tests, CI concepts, reproducible pipelines); (5) production-aware deployment and MLOps basics (Docker, REST, SageMaker/ECS concepts); and (6) interview readiness through continuous DSA practice and a dedicated final-month mock-interview sprint. This combination maximizes hiring probability for AI/ML Engineer roles by aligning time with high-impact skills employers validate in interviews: coding + algorithms, ML modeling depth, practical deployment experience, and clear portfolio artifacts to discuss during screens.
